The complaint of the petitioner is that despite applications for registration and licence submitted as early as on 27.08.2020 and 16.09.2020 respectively, the respondents are not taking any action to consider the same.
2. The learned Government Pleader on instructions submits that registration is already granted and the application for licence is pending.

Therefore, the Writ Petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondents that in case registration is granted, the certificate shall be forwarded to the petitioner within a period of two weeks.

Sd/- (P.V.ASHA, JUDGE)
